vor_rt_slow_curse: slowly winds black thread around a small straw doll by candlelight, whispering, patient and cruel.
vor_rt_hidden_needle: draws a long bone needle hidden in her braid, holding it up in the dim light with a thin smile.
vor_rt_grave_harvest: kneels in a moonlit graveyard gathering black wilted flowers from a fresh grave into her apron.
vor_pw_crow_familiar: with a large black crow perched on her shoulder, both staring at the viewer with the same white eyes.
vor_pw_bitter_tongue: spits a bitter curse word towards a cowering creature, her lips black, smoke curling from her mouth.
vor_pw_creeping_rot: stands among fallen dead creatures as green-black rot creeps from them across the ground towards more enemies.
vor_pw_tainted_blade: smears a sickle blade with black ooze from a clay pot, the metal pitting and rusting where it touches.
vor_pw_sabbath: dances wildly around a bonfire with shadowy witches at night on a bare hill, hair flying.
vor_pw_black_moon: raises both arms towards a black eclipsed moon with a thin red ring, the forest below in darkness.
vor_pw_death_kiss: leans down and kisses the forehead of a dying dark creature, its last breath drifting into her mouth.
